title: FormLayout 表单布局
description: 原生 form，字段排布在响应式网格上；提交、重置和校验保持原生行为。

wc:minerva-form-layout.summary: Responsive column grid for form fields.
wc:minerva-form-layout.description: Lays the fields of a form out on a responsive column grid (`<FormLayout>` of React): the same container-query grid as `<minerva-responsive-grid>`, with the form's width / margin / padding variables. Difference from React: the React library's FormLayout renders the `<form>` itself. A `<form>` inside a shadow root cannot own the light DOM fields, so this element is the layout only: place it inside a native `<form>` (`<form><minerva-form-layout columns="1 2">...</minerva-form-layout></form>`), which keeps submit, reset and validation native. Wrap a field in `<minerva-grid-item full-width>` to span a row.

properties.name: columns
properties.description: Column counts (integers 1-12): a number, `"1 2 3 4"` (base sm md lg) or `{ base, sm, md, lg }` (container widths 480 / 768 / 1200px)

properties.name: gap
properties.description: Gap between fields (spacing token number or CSS value)

parts.name: root
parts.description: The form layout box (React: the native <form>; web components: the grid's query container, inside your own <form>)

parts.name: layout
parts.description: The grid. Web components only: React renders a nested ResponsiveGrid (style its `responsive-grid` hooks)

cssProperties.name: --responsive-grid-align-items
cssProperties.description: Vertical alignment of the items in their row (default: stretch)

cssProperties.name: --responsive-grid-justify-items
cssProperties.description: Horizontal alignment of the items in their column (default: stretch)

cssProperties.name: --form-layout-max-width
cssProperties.description: Maximum width of the form (none by default)

cssProperties.name: --form-layout-margin-inline
cssProperties.description: Inline margin of the form (set auto with a max width to center it)

vars.name: --form-layout-max-width
vars.description: Maximum width of the form (none by default)

vars.name: --form-layout-margin-inline
vars.description: Inline margin of the form (set auto with a max width to center it)

examples.title: 基础用法
examples.description: 将布局放在原生 <form> 内：提交、重置和校验保持原生行为。columns="1 2" 在窄容器中为一列，480px 起为两列；minerva-grid-item full-width 占满一整行。

files.apps/docs/src/docs/pages/form-layout/wc/:
<form style="display: grid; gap: 24px">
  <minerva-form-layout columns="1 2 3" row-gap="6" column-gap="2">
    <label style="display: grid; gap: 4px">
      City
      <input name="city" />
    </label>
    <label style="display: grid; gap: 4px">
      State
      <input name="state" />
    </label>
    <label style="display: grid; gap: 4px">
      ZIP
      <input name="zip" inputmode="numeric" />
    </label>
  </minerva-form-layout>
  <minerva-form-layout columns="2" gap="24px">
    <label style="display: grid; gap: 4px">
      Start date
      <input name="start" type="date" />
    </label>
    <label style="display: grid; gap: 4px">
      End date
      <input name="end" type="date" />
    </label>
  </minerva-form-layout>
</form>

examples.title: 列与间距
examples.description: gap 同时设置两个方向的间距；row-gap 和 column-gap 可分别覆盖（间距令牌数字或 CSS 长度）。同样适用于原生字段。

basic.description: columns 跟随表单自身宽度；GridItem fullWidth asChild 让 FormField 占满整行且不额外包裹。

gaps.title: 间距
gaps.description: gap、rowGap 和 columnGap 接受间距 token 或 CSS 值。

FormLayoutProps.columns: 内部 ResponsiveGrid 的列数：数字或 `{ base, sm, md, lg }`（容器宽度 480 / 768 / 1200px），1-12 的整数
FormLayoutProps.gap: 字段间距：数字和数字字符串对应间距 token，其他字符串为 CSS 值

cssVars.--form-layout-max-width: 表单最大宽度（默认不限制）
cssVars.--form-layout-margin-inline: 表单的行内方向外边距（配合最大宽度设为 auto 可居中）
